notes: Three repetitions per build, order reversed on the second. Sequential four-worker relays on CPUs 0-3 and the same frozen client on CPUs 4-7. Two retained global sessions, three waves of 8192 transient peers in distinct rooms, three seconds of verified traffic before any wave and after each. Timed routing excludes filling/draining; their native CPU cost is recorded separately. Post-wave medians are first taken per process, then across process medians. No profiled timing is included.
prototype_status: Departure-only prototype, retained as exploratory evidence. The selected change also handles ID retirement through occupied fixed-ID takeover and receives a separate final comparison.
